rule: The map has every partisan race for a federal, state, county, township or town office on the county's general-election ballots in 2020, 2022 and 2024, the years with precinct results in the guide: President, Congress, statewide offices, the State Senate and State House districts that include part of the county, county offices and judges elected on a party ballot, the county commissioner and county council districts, and, on the 2022 ballot (the only one of the three with them), township trustee, township board and township assessor races and town council races. No city office was on these ballots: South Bend and Mishawaka elect theirs in odd years. Races with no more candidates than seats are included and marked uncontested. In races electing several members (vote for 2 or 3), each party's share is of all votes cast for that party's candidates, and the winners are listed. Left out: judicial retention votes and public questions (yes-or-no questions with no candidates) and school board races (nonpartisan). Offices are listed in the order they appear on the ballot under Indiana law. The race shown first is the top race on the most recent ballot, so the choice does not depend on who won.
note: Races and their order follow RACE_RULE in tools/build_map.py. Vote vectors are D, R, L, other party, write-ins; for townships and places a sixth number counts the precincts summed, and 'n' counts the precincts each area had in each election year (any race). 'pair' is the two parties with the most votes in the race (the margin's two sides). 'county' sums every precinct in the race (for district races: every precinct in the district inside the county), including precincts with no Census 2020 boundary. Built by tools/build_map.py from precinct_results.csv.
